label: 74HC161 4-bit Synchronous Binary Counter with Async Clear

semantics.notes: 4-bit binary counter, counts 0-15. ASYNC clear via /CLRN (active-low, overrides clock). Synchronous parallel load via /LDN (active-low, loads d0-d3 at next CLK↑ when /LDN=0). ENP and ENT must both be 1 for counting. RCO=1 when Q=15 AND ENT=1 (ripple carry out for cascading). Key distinction from 74HC163: /CLR is asynchronous here.

exportSupport.verilogNotes: always @(posedge clk or negedge clrn) — async /CLR. Counter increment inside clocked block. RCO via assign.
exportSupport.vhdlNotes: process(clk, clrn) — async reset in sensitivity list.

testability.notes: Tests: count 0→15 with ENP=ENT=1; verify RCO=1 only at count=15 with ENT=1; async /CLRN=0 resets immediately (not waiting for clock edge); parallel load /LDN=0 at CLK↑ loads D[3:0]; hold when ENP=0 or ENT=0; cascade: connect RCO to ENP of next stage. Verify /CLRN is truly async (resets mid-clock-cycle).

risks.description: 74HC161 has ASYNC clear. 74HC163 has SYNCHRONOUS clear. The two are commonly confused. Correct distinction must be verified in the implementation.
RCO condition: real 74HC161 datasheet shows RCO=1 when count=15 AND ENT=1. Implementation must be checked to confirm ENT is included in RCO logic.

modelLimits: Modulus is always 16 (binary 4-bit). No variable modulus.
Uses internal extra reg (cnt_xxx) in HDL export.
Propagation delay 20ns applies uniformly to all outputs.
